title: Major Horror Anime Drops New Opening Ahead of Netflix Debut – Watch Now

title: Historie Anime Reveals New Visual, Trailer Additional Cast
content: The previously announced Historie anime revealed a new visual and trailer on Wednesday along with additional voice cast members. Studio LIDEN FILMS is animating the series, set to premiere in January 8, 2027.

title: Link Click Season 3 Confirms 2027 Return for Part 2 With New Look
content: Link Click confirms a 2027 release window for Season 3 Part 2. Crunchyroll brought back the new season of this beloved series in August this year as part of the Summer 2026 anime lineup.

title: Kindergarten WARS Unveils New Visual and Trailer, Opening Theme Song Artist Ado
content: Kindergarten WARS anime has unveiled the main visual and a new trailer on Wednesday. The latest trailer features the opening theme song “Bibayatarametta” by Ado. The series debuts in April 2027. Studio Sunrise and Felix Film are animating the series with Shinsuke Gomi as director.

title: Demon Slayer Studio’s New Movie Confirms Return With New Sequel
content: The newest movie from the studio behind the Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba anime franchise has announced it’s now working on a new sequel to its latest release, Witch on the Holy Night. Studio Ufotable has been busy the last few years with all sorts of new projects now in various stages of development.

title: Now That We Draw Anime Reveals New Trailer, Main Visual, Additional Cast, Ending Theme Song Artist
content: Now That We Draw anime revealed a new trailer and a main visual. Additionally, Hina Youmiya joins the cast and Inner Journey sings “Serifu wa Iranai” for the ending theme song. The series is set to premiere on January 8, 2027, and it stars Sayumi Suzushiro stars as Niina Miyamoto and Ayumu Murase as Yuuki Uehara.
